notes: SECURITY FIX: ADMINISTRATOR RIGHTS COULD BE TAKEN. A signed-in user without finance rights could give themselves administrator and finance rights through a crafted request. This release closes it, both in the app and in the database itself, every time the app starts. Nothing changes for normal use. After installing, look over Administration, Users & Roles and confirm each person has the role you gave them. Please install this update. Carries everything in 0.6.137. Installing: no migration and no change to your data. Please take a backup first: Backup and Export, Back up now.
